budget_items.topic: Snow and ice removal budget and deficit spending
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The latest snow and ice expenditure report showed a budget, expenditures and in-process invoices; KS requested approval of deficit spending under MGL Chapter 44, Section 31D.
budget_items.quote: the report shows a budget of $250,000, expenditures of $236,528.93, in-process invoices of $30,243.85.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Preliminary FY2012 budget proposal shows property tax revenue increasing by 4.21%.
Preliminary FY2012 budget proposal shows total revenue increasing by 1.3%.
Preliminary FY2012 budget proposal shows expenditures increasing by 2.03%, with a focus on services, not employees.
budget_items.quote: expenditures increase by 2.03%, with a focus on services, not employees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Debt service decreases by $107,000 after including the loan on the new DPW facility.
budget_items.quote: debt service decreases by $107,000, after including the loan on the new dpw facility.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: KS recommended a 2.5% increase for schools, significantly less than the superintendent's recommendation, reflecting declining enrollments.
budget_items.quote: ks recommends 2.5% increase in schools, noting this is significantly less than the superintendants recommendation

budget_items.topic: Health insurance costs in school budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school committee chair asked that health insurance costs be taken out of the school budget to show school costs more fairly; KS said the schools budget must include them and agreed to show town-wide totals in aggregate. No figures printed.
budget_items.quote: he asked if health insurance costs could be taken out from the school budget, as it is from other department budgets, to spotlight these costs and show school costs more fairly.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: KS said future borrowing for school buildings would be exempt debt, so the impact is small; debt service peaked in FY11 and continues to decline. No figures printed.
budget_items.quote: ks noted that this would be exempt debt, so the impact is small.
